subject: closed cloth-bound academy field dossier with blank paper tabs and an oxidized brass retaining strip
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: independent OCC startup page background source for a Unity UI, no interface baked in
Primary request: closed cloth-bound academy field dossier with blank paper tabs and an oxidized brass retaining strip
Scene/backdrop: near-modern rustic academy aether-industry expressed through warm paper, cloth folders, old wood, forged iron and very limited oxidized brass
Composition/framing: exact 16:9 landscape, straight-on or shallow top-down; keep the central 55 percent calm, pale and low contrast for real UI cards and text; concentrate narrative objects at the edges and corners
Style/medium: deliberately coarse hand-clustered pixel-art background, large readable clusters, crisp stair-step edges, restrained material detail
Lighting/mood: soft upper-left daylight, quiet practical archival atmosphere, no dramatic glow
Color palette: warm paper white, archive beige, charcoal ink, muted wood brown; only tiny functional accents of oxidized brass, medical green, sealed red, or active-aether cyan where appropriate
Constraints: background artwork only; no people; no letters, words, numbers, fake writing, title, buttons, cards, icon slots or complete UI; all visible paper surfaces blank or marked only by non-semantic wear
Avoid: blue-black full screen, cyan borders, terminal grid, scanlines, hologram, radar, oscilloscope, sci-fi console, steampunk gear clutter, medieval parchment curls, wax-seal excess, holy glow, gradients, bloom, soft focus, anti-aliased vector look, watermark
